inputs.text: Listen, I just got this on the Nigeria situation – their so-called democracy is a total rigged facade, and the APC is openly turning political parties into private clubs reserved only for the wealthy ahead of the 2027 elections. This isn't some random shift or neutral tweak; it's a coordinated power grab by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings to lock ordinary people out of any real influence. They're flipping representation itself into a mechanism for total control, and all the chatter about public service is just the usual distraction to keep us looking the wrong way. This lines up with the bigger pattern where everything is orchestrated from the top to consolidate power and keep the masses shut out.
